d:
Bihar ke prasiddh lekhak aur aadhyatmik chintak do. vikram mishra ne pujy devarha baba ke jivan aur unki aadhyatmik virasat ko bare parde par lane ki ghoshna ki hai. unki bestaselar kitab 'mahadev ansh' par aadharit philm 'rudrayogi' ke jarie desh-duniya men shraddha aur aastha ke kendr rahe devarha baba ke jivan se jure prasangon ko sinemaee rup diya jaega.
